title: Node id present
description: Every node object carries an @id. A node object with no @id becomes a blank node: the processor mints a label scoped to one parse, which nothing in the document text names and nothing outside it can reference. A missing @base makes every identifier resolve somewhere unintended and is repairable by anyone who knows where the document came from; a blank node cannot be repaired at all.

then.errorMessage: node object with no @id -- it becomes a blank node, which nothing outside this document can reference

$comment: The outermost object of a document carrying @graph is a document object, not a node object, and needs no @id of its own. Everything inside it is swept.
